name: Nevis
summary: Nevis’s chronology differs from its divided northern neighbour.
notes: French raids in 1706 devastated Nevis, but the island did not share Saint Kitts’s long Anglo-French partition. Nevis became independent as part of the federation, not as a separate sovereign state.

events.title: Spain claims Nevis
events.detail: Columbus sighted the island without establishing a Spanish colony.
events.qualification: A European claim; it does not establish island-wide administration or extinguish Indigenous rights.

events.title: English colonists settle Nevis
events.detail: An English colony grew separately from Saint Kitts.

events.title: Spanish expedition
events.detail: Spain temporarily displaced the new colony.

events.title: English settlement resumes
events.detail: Colonists returned after the Spanish expedition.

events.title: French forces sack Nevis
events.detail: A devastating raid included the capture and removal of enslaved people.

events.title: France occupies Nevis
events.detail: French conquest of the neighbouring islands reached Nevis.

events.title: Nevis restored to Britain
events.detail: The peace settlement ended the French occupation.

events.title: Independence in the federation
events.detail: Nevis joined the sovereign Federation of Saint Kitts and Nevis with local self-government.
